claims: NVIDIA officially announced that DLSS 5 is scheduled for release in Fall 2026.
DLSS 5 is designed for next-generation GPUs expected to be the RTX 50-series.
DLSS 5 focuses on neural rendering for photorealistic lighting and materials.
DLSS 5 is expected to be optimized for GeForce RTX 50-series GPUs.
DLSS 5 acts as a "GPT moment for graphics."
DLSS 5 focuses on AI-infused neural rendering for lighting and materials rather than just upscaling.
Upcoming titles supporting DLSS 5 include Aion 2, Assassin's Creed Shadows, and Resident Evil Requiem.
DLSS 5 was announced at GTC 2026 alongside the immediate launch of DLSS 4.5 features for existing cards.
